scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,cyan "uv run uvicorn main:app --app-dir backend/src --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8765 --reload" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.dev:desktop: concurrently -k -n web,desktop -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w apps/web" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5180 && npm run dev -w apps/desktop"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/web && npm run typecheck -w apps/desktop
scripts.test: uv run pytest && npm run typecheck
